name: xq-jewy
description: MCP server for XQ backend-testing tools (Node.js + TypeScript scaffold)

scripts.format: prettier --write src test vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json README.md CHANGELOG.md .prettierrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json README.md CHANGELOG.md .prettierrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.test: vitest run --coverage --project unit --project integration && vitest run --project system
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
